title: csid: a Wi-Fi channel state information capture daemon and the CSIQ format
description: A systemd-native Wi-Fi Channel State Information capture daemon for Intel AX210 radios on Linux 6.x, and CSIQ, a self-describing and versioned interchange format for CSI with reference readers in Rust and Python. Every session writes a sidecar with the radio configuration, firmware, kernel, driver module, regulatory domain and governor before capture starts.
